title: Crossing Pedestrian: B0 Blind Commitment vs B1 Perceptual Rerouting

mode_b0_baseline.hazard_description: Commits straight forward through corridor despite crossing entity exiting FOV in 1.45s, blinding forward tracking.

mode_b1_stage_a.hazard_description: Straight corridor rejected (support 0.335 < 0.40). Successfully reroutes to RIGHT corridor (support 0.909 >= 0.40).

scientific_significance: Proves Stage-A prevents blind corridor commitment when obstacle observation cannot be guaranteed over horizon H.
